name: Seasoned Warrenguard
description: Whenever this creature attacks while you control a token, it gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
notes: First attempt found a real, recurring gap: IsPresent$ ("attacks WHILE YOU CONTROL A TOKEN") had no handling on trigger nodes at all -- the trigger-level sibling of ConditionPresent$ (same board-state existence check, different field name). Implemented a shared ifPresentFlag helper (cond:if_present=<type>), wired into trigger nodes (IsPresent$) and the generic emit fallback + Scry (ConditionPresent$) -- fixes Sonar Strike and Rabbit Response's chained Scry in the same batch. Also refined it to fall back to a qualifier (e.g. .token) when the base type is a generic wildcard like Permanent/Card, since the real distinguishing fact often lives there, not in the base type. Verified: node C now shows cond:if_present=token, exact match. In blb-success.json.
